summary.text: Kyle Pierce is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 36, assumed office on November 9, 2022, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Kimberly Townsend (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Pierce lives in Anderson, Indiana, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Ball State University in 2016 and a juris doctor from Indiana University.

His career experience includes work as a communications consultant, a project manager with Argo Strategy, the director of development with the Ball State University Foundation, and a legislative assistant with the Indiana House of Representatives.
Pierce succeeded Terri Austin (D) in District 36.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Elections and Apportionment and Environmental Affairs committees and as vice chair of Financial Institutions and Insurance.
